version: Flutter 3.47.8 (framework 737ba8f885, engine cf636b1dfb), Dart 3.13.7, package:ffi 2.2.0, Impeller-GLES
notes: Flutter Dart-AOT release, Linux GTK3 embedder, renderer: Impeller (OpenGL ES backend, default), GL = Mesa (llvmpipe under Xvfb). frame_ms = interval between consecutive FrameTiming rasterFinish timestamps (SchedulerBinding.addTimingsCallback; raster thread finished the frame and handed it to the GTK GL compositor; latest public post-render signal, not an X11 present timestamp). Only frames the engine rasterized are counted (Flutter produces no frame when nothing is dirty; every animated frame changes content). Cadence cap ~60 Hz: the Linux embedder registers no vsync callback, so the engine uses its fallback vsync waiter with a fixed 1/60 s tick (engine source shell/common/vsync_waiter_fallback.cc); no public option to disable it, kept. gc = null: Dart exposes no GC counters in AOT release. Warm-up 2 s; script time frozen at 0 during warm-up. list = ListView.builder(itemExtentBuilder: known per-row heights h(i)) (SliverVariedExtentList); scroll set by ScrollController.jumpTo in a Ticker callback from the closed-form script.
